k-sym-BAWSAQ.title: BAWSAQ GTA stock-exchange coins
k-sym-BAWSAQ.sourceSays: Posts say BAWSAQ is the in-game stock exchange parodying NASDAQ from GTA, now a Solana coin; an account using the BAWSAQ name pitches a GTA stocks app. Identity of the accounts is unverified.
k-sym-BAWSAQ.reason: Posts of Nov 10 and Nov 17 describe the GTA-parody BAWSAQ concept and a daily news item on the GTA-themed coin; several copycat tickers exist, claims unverified.
